title: Qwen 3.8 for game dev?
author: mh_1039
selftext:
I've been developing my game sporadically using Claude and Grok for a little less than a year. Recently, I've been given access to a local LLM machine running Qwen3.8. Has anyone used Qwen for their game development? I love the idea of having more control, not paying the subscription, and not worrying about tokens in the same way, but I also don't want to get in a situation where I've totally compromised on actual ability.

I personally do code in multiple languages and I'm just building out essentially a TCG/LCG, not a 4X or FPS game or something like that.

comments.author: hiImMate
comments.body: I made a full game with 3.8 Flash Next, it worked wonderfully. For TCG/LCG which is not physics heavy anyway I think it will work super well.

replies.author: mh_1039
replies.body: Awesome to hear. Every post here seems to insist on some flavor of Claude/GPT so I was concerned the Qwen version just wasn't up to task

replies.author: count023
replies.body: More a case of people of having the grunt to run larger Qwen models locally

comments.author: Advanced_Invite9435
comments.body: I was thinking of using Qwen local for NPC's diaglog generation.
